utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina—before we make any decisions, can you tell me what you’ve heard about the repair drive so far, especially the time, place, and repair list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nothing final yet: Rey’s bringing the names, skills, and top three repairs tonight, and Pia’s checking the community room and rules. Can you help Saturday morning, and what tools or repair skills can we count on from you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can pencil in Saturday morning, but I won’t confirm until Pia has the room and rules and Rey’s repair list is posted. Count me for signup/check-in and a basic toolkit if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I’m helping with tables, tool bins, and extension cords Saturday morning, but I’m still trying to confirm the exact time and repair list—have you heard anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve only got the same rough picture so far: Saturday drop-off with labeled broken items, spare tools if folks have them, and I’m covering sign-in before sorting or hauling late morning. I’ll pass along the exact time and repair list as soon as someone confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane—that matches what I’ve heard. I’ll keep prepping tables, bins, and cords, and I’ll pass along the time and repair list once either of us gets it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, I’m still waiting on Nell and Marisol to confirm the time and place for the repair drive, but Dane can help later with sorting or hauling and Jules can help match people to roles once we know more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Vik—but can you confirm whether Pia or the office has posted the accepted repair items too? I’d rather wait on the exact time, place, and list before telling anyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I haven’t seen a confirmed accepted-items list from Pia or the office yet, Kira, so I’ll hold off and pass it along once the time, place, and list are actually posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, we’re still waiting on Nell and Marisol for the final time and place, but I’m already matching people to sorting, hauling, sign-in, and repair roles. Is there anyone from your circle who might want to jump in once we’ve got the details?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can ask a few school parents at pickup today, but I’ll frame it as tentative until Nell and Marisol confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Faye—thank you. If any of them have a preference, just note whether they’d rather sort, haul, handle sign-in, or do repairs, and I’ll plug them in once the details are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, I’m tracking the repair drive by confirmed locations—do you have any items coming from your place, or a pickup/drop-off spot I should add?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—put my porch down as the drop-off spot for exterior screws, wrench sets, pliers, and plumber’s tape; I’ll keep them sorted for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Cleo—I’ll mark your porch as the confirmed drop-off for exterior screws, wrench sets, pliers, and plumber’s tape, sorted for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn, I’m a bit behind and still haven’t seen the confirmed time, place, or accepted repair items. I’m waiting on Pia or the office before I tell folks anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That matches what I’ve got, Noah—I won’t pass along a definite time or place yet, just that the drive may focus on leaky gutters and porch steps until Pia or the office confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn—that sounds sensible. I’ll hold off too and just tell anyone interested that we’re waiting on Pia or the office for the real details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Leo. I’m still waiting for Nell and Marisol to confirm the time and place, plus a posted repair list, before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Eli. I’m still waiting on firm time and place too—once Nell or Marisol posts it, I’ll pass along the repair list and you can decide then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Leo—that’s exactly the kind of clear plan I need. Once the time, place, and repair list are posted, I’ll take a proper look and decide.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Pia, I’m still waiting on a firm kickoff time for the repair drive, so please don’t pass 3:30 to 5 around as certain yet. Sam’s got tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered, at least.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—I won’t treat 3:30 to 5 as confirmed yet. I’m checking with the building office today, and I’ll ask about the room rules, final time, and accepted items before telling Kira or anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thank you, Pia—once the office gives you the final time and item rules, send them my way and I’ll pass along the clean version.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Uli, quick heads-up: I can bring a couple extension cords and do first-hour check-in Saturday, but I’m tight after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo—that would help a lot. I’ll keep you to first-hour check-in and a couple cords, but I’ll confirm with Rosa or Hana once the signup sheet’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just send me the final time and spot once Rosa or Hana confirms, and I’ll keep it to cords plus the first hour.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, thanks again for pulling together the names, skills, and urgent repairs tonight—once you have the list, I’ll match the top three and send them to Mina without promising times or tools yet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Mara—I’ll keep it simple and only include what’s confirmed, especially any urgent repairs and tools people can actually bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rey—send it when you have it, and I’ll keep Mina’s update clear and tentative until Pia confirms the room and rules.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I’m checking around about the repair drive—Mara says they’re still gathering repair items and volunteers, maybe with Noah helping Saturday afternoon. Have you heard any firm time or list of repairs yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard a firm time yet, Ira, so I wouldn’t treat Saturday afternoon as confirmed. Second-hand, I’ve only heard the list may include leaky gutters and broken porch steps, plus Sam has tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell—that’s helpful, and I’ll be careful not to call Saturday afternoon confirmed yet. I’ll pass along that gutters and porch steps may be on the list and that Sam’s got tables, tool bins, and cords covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Can you still help, and is there anything you’re able to bring or pick up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for letting me know, Rosa—Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my toolbox and some extra cords, and I can pick up screws or hardware if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thanks Gus—that toolbox and the extra cords will be a big help. If you can pick up a mixed box of screws and any spare tape or anchors, I’ll add you to the Sunday supply list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, thanks again for checking with Bo and Noah—could you let me know by tomorrow whether they can still help Sunday at the community center and what supplies they’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll check with Bo and Noah today and send you only what they confirm by tomorrow so your volunteer and supply list stays tidy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Faye—that’ll make it much easier to match people and tools for Sunday. I’ll hold their spots as pending until I hear from you tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Dane—I’ll bring the labeled broken stuff, a couple spare tools, and the extension cords, and I can cover first-hour check-in Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Bo—thank you. I’ll keep sign-in covered after the first hour and point you toward Leo if hauling still needs hands late morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I’ll do the first hour, then check with Leo before I bail if hauling still needs a quick hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Oren — I’m quietly checking nearby for repair needs and spare screws, wrench sets, or plumber’s tape before evening. Do you know of anything urgent, or anyone I should note for Mara and Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Rey, yes—my note says the loose railing by the community steps is first, then the leaky hose bib near the garden. Cleo asked for wrench, pliers, and spare screws; I’m still checking my wandering toolbox, but plumber’s tape would likely help too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I’ll note the loose railing first, then the hose bib, and pass along that wrench, pliers, spare screws, and plumber’s tape may be needed. If your toolbox turns up any of those, just tell me quietly before evening.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Uli—I'm still set for Saturday with my toolbox, and Sam’s helping with tables and cords if you need us pointed anywhere first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Gus—thank you. If you and Sam can start with the tables by the laundry room Saturday, I’ll bring the short list of urgent fixes and point you where the toolbox is needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Uli—we’ll start with the tables by the laundry room Saturday morning, and I’ll keep the toolbox handy for your urgent-fix list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check with the building office today about the community room, timing, rules, and accepted items before anyone announces it. For tools, let’s only pencil in Tomas’s drill, June’s wrenches, and my sewing kit until they confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Pia—please let me know once the room, time, rules, and accepted repair list are confirmed. I’ll stay penciled out until it’s posted clearly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli—I’ll circle back after I hear from the office, and I won’t ask anyone to post or commit until the room, time, rules, and item list are actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, I’m still waiting on the firm kickoff time, but we’ll need tool check-in, sorting, and some late-morning hauling help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I’ll mark the kickoff time as pending and note tool check-in, sorting, and late-morning hauling as needs. Do you have confirmed locations for where tools check in and where sorted items should be staged?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tool check-in will be at my garage for now; stage sorted items along the church basement wall unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn, I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and place, so please keep it tentative for now—what I’ve heard is the drive may focus on leaky gutters and broken porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep it tentative and only tell folks the focus may be leaky gutters and broken porch steps until you confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn, I really appreciate that—once I hear the confirmed time and place, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, I’ve got the loose railing by the community steps as first priority, then the leaky garden hose bib; the drive’s now Sunday at the community center, but kickoff time is still pending.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll pass along that the railing is priority one and the hose bib next, with Sunday at the community center confirmed. I’ll keep listening for the kickoff time before telling folks when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Ira—if anyone asks what to bring, I’m still short on exterior screws, wrench sets, pliers, and plumber’s tape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do we have a confirmed location and start time yet, or are we still guessing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still waiting on Nell and Marisol to confirm the location and start time, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’m lining up roles in the meantime so we can move quickly once they pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—then who’s confirmed for roles so far, and do we have anyone besides Gus bringing tools Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana, we’re still gathering repair items and volunteers, and I’m waiting on Rey’s list tonight before I match the top repairs—if you know any urgent fixes or available tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara—I’ve heard Oren has railing first and then a leaky hose bib, and he may bring a wrench, pliers, and screws. I’ll wait for Rey’s list before treating anything as final.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana—that’s really helpful; I’ll mark Oren’s railing as the priority and the hose bib as next, with those tools tentative until Rey’s list and Pia’s room rules are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Tess, I’m a little behind on the repair drive—have you seen any confirmed time, place, or accepted items yet, or should I wait for Pia or the office before I pass anything along?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hold off for now, Noah—I still don’t have the time or place confirmed, and I don’t want 3:30 to 5 getting treated as official. Sam’s set for tables, tool bins, and extension cords, but let’s wait on Pia or the office before you pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I won’t repeat 3:30 to 5 or any item list as official yet. I’ll wait for Pia or the office and just let Jules know I’m still on standby to ask around.
